header footer:
<class name="header footer" code="w223" description="Represents a single header or footer." plural="header footers">
			<element type="page number" />
			<element type="shape" />
			<property name="header footer index" code="3140" type="WdHeaderFooterIndex" access="r" description="Returns a constant that represents the specified header or footer in a document or section." />
			<property name="is header" code="3141" type="boolean" access="r" description="Returns true if this object is a header." />
			<property name="link to previous" code="3145" type="boolean" description="Returns or sets if the specified header or footer is linked to the corresponding header or footer in the previous section. When a header or footer is linked, its contents are the same as in the previous header or footer." />
			<property name="page number options" code="wPnO" type="page number options" access="r" description="Return the page number options object associated with this header footer object." />
			<property name="text object" code="wTxR" type="text range" access="r" description="Returns a text range object that represents the text for the header or footer." />
		</class>
get header:
<command name="get header" code="sTXTwGhr" description="Returns a specific header object">
			<direct-parameter type="section" />
			<parameter name="index" code="wHFi" type="WdHeaderFooterIndex" description="Specifies which header to retrieve." />
			<result type="header footer" />
		</command>
get footer:
<command name="get footer" code="sTXTwGft" description="Returns a specific footer object">
			<direct-parameter type="section" />
			<parameter name="index" code="wHFi" type="WdHeaderFooterIndex" description="Specifies which footer to retrieve." />
			<result type="header footer" />
		</command>
get story range:
<command name="get story range" code="sWRDWGSr" description="Returns a range object that represents the story specified by the story type argument.">

			<result type="story range" />
